source: can you please make me a 3d xombe apocalypse game with guns and it is based in a spooky abandoned arcade please

image_prompt.text: Narrow transitions between the arcade rows where routes meet, concentrating fights into contested ground
A derelict arcade entered from the street frontage, with the whole play space sitting inside it

layout_placement.text: Where the zombies enter the arcade, sited so players have a readable direction to hold against

notes: PvE Shooter preset taken whole; building-interior forces P3, so the interior is generated separately.
The entire map is an interior, which building-interior only approximates.

open_questions.ask: Is the win condition surviving waves against a timer, clearing the arcade, or escaping it?
Should the arcade be a single room-sized floor or a larger multi-room block?

coverage_missing.ask: Is the win condition surviving waves against a timer, clearing the arcade, or escaping it?
Should the arcade be a single room-sized floor or a larger multi-room block?

answers.ask: Is the win condition surviving waves against a timer, clearing the arcade, or escaping it?
answers.answer: Make it a simple wave-survival game: survive zombie waves against a timer.

answers.ask: Should the arcade be a single room-sized floor or a larger multi-room block?
answers.answer: Use a single room-sized arcade floor to keep it focused and playable.
